description: This Java source file defines an abstract class 'AnySoftKeyboardClipboard' which manages clipboard interactions, including copying, pasting, and clipboard entry management, within the AnySoftKeyboard Android keyboard app. It includes inner classes for clipboard UI components and handles clipboard synchronization, user interactions, and clipboard data operations.

classes.name: ClipboardStripActionProvider
classes.description: A UI component that provides a clipboard suggestion action view, including animations and click handling for clipboard text display and options.

classes.name: ClipboardEntriesAdapter
classes.description: An ArrayAdapter subclass for displaying clipboard entries in a dialog, with delete functionality.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes clipboard management, sets up clipboard update listener, and reads user preferences for clipboard sync.

methods.name: onClipboardEntryChanged
methods.description: Handles updates to clipboard entries, updating UI and internal state accordingly.

methods.name: showClipboardActionIcon
methods.description: Displays the clipboard entry icon in the input view, updating its content and visibility.

methods.name: onStartInputView
methods.description: Handles logic when input view starts, including showing clipboard hints based on timing and clipboard state.

methods.name: isTextPassword
methods.description: Determines if the current input field is a password field based on EditorInfo inputType.

methods.name: onKey
methods.description: Handles key events, including dismissing clipboard UI after timeout.

methods.name: onFinishInputView
methods.description: Removes clipboard UI components when input view finishes.

methods.name: showAllClipboardEntries
methods.description: Displays a dialog with all clipboard entries for user selection or management.

methods.name: performPaste
methods.description: Performs a paste operation via the OS clipboard.

methods.name: performCopy
methods.description: Performs copy or cut operation via key events.

methods.name: handleClipboardOperation
methods.description: Handles clipboard-related key operations such as paste, copy, cut, select all, undo, redo.

methods.name: handleSelectionExpending
methods.description: Expands text selection based on arrow key input when arrow selection mode is active.

methods.name: onPress
methods.description: Handles key press events, especially to disable arrow selection mode.
